chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Ibrahim ibn Abd al-Hamid, from Musa ibn Ukayl al-Numayri, from al-Ala' ibn Sayabah, from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام.
Surely this Qur'an guides to that which is most upright.
He عليه السلام said: "It guides to the Imam."

key_terms.أَقْوَمُ: most upright, most correct and firmly established
key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the divinely designated guide and leader
key_terms.الْقُرْآنَ: the Qur'an, the divine revelation that provides guidance
key_terms.قَوْلِهِ: His saying, referring to the cited divine statement
key_terms.يَهْدِي: guides, directs toward the correct path

ai.seo_question: According to Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام, what does the Qur'an guide people to in verse 17:9?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse stating that the Qur'an guides to what is most upright. Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام explains that this guidance leads to the Imam, indicating that right guidance is inseparable from rightful divinely appointed authority.
